Platform Engineer - Wrenfield Digital

About the role
Wrenfield Digital runs a booking platform for independent hotels. We are hiring a platform engineer to join a team of six. We do not use rigid job levels, so below is simply what the work looks like day to day.

Responsibilities
- You will build and maintain REST APIs in Python that power our booking and payment pages.
- You will run these services on AWS and keep them reliable, including a share of the on-call rotation.
- You will write SQL against PostgreSQL for reporting and for tuning slow queries.
- You will take part in code review for your colleagues' changes and expect the same in return.
- You will help shape our deployment pipeline and monitoring as the team grows.

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
